# Kafka KIP compatibility matrix

<!-- Generated by tools/generate-kip-matrix.py; do not edit by hand. -->

This matrix records the repository's JVM differential evidence for the Kafka
on-disk log contract. The suite covers timestamped record batches (KIP-32),
segment and index discovery, and record key/value recovery in both directions.

| Direction | Status | Contract | Owner | Differential test | Kafka image |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| JVM -> krabka | Implemented | Open and read a JVM-written Kafka log directory | [`crates/log`](../crates/log) | [`read_jvm_produced_log_dir`](../crates/log/tests/integration.rs) | `mirror.gcr.io/confluentinc/cp-kafka:6.1.1@sha256:537c303f182ff6ba665f324520105c44970c97d7ef94b306709a5d68b8c1aed7` |
| krabka -> JVM | Implemented | Restart Kafka over a krabka-written log directory and consume it | [`crates/log`](../crates/log) | [`jvm_consumes_rust_written_log_dir`](../crates/log/tests/integration.rs) | `mirror.gcr.io/confluentinc/cp-kafka:6.1.1@sha256:537c303f182ff6ba665f324520105c44970c97d7ef94b306709a5d68b8c1aed7` |
